owner_approval.source: Tamam onayliyorum Codex — explicit approval after the concrete four EO05D jobs were listed: yesterday/today bootstrap; replace same-day value3 with5 rather than sum8; duplicate-safe durable completion; raw-to-physical report comparison/mismatch record. Code, necessary SQL preparation, isolated tests and ONE PR; no live DB/provider/config/merge/deploy.

bootstrap.eligibility: Day crossing eligibleFromMs is unavailable; no fabricated partial-day or disconnected backfill policy
bootstrap.advance: Only current DB-confirmed exact owner/date/timezone receipt; clone or unknown stops
bootstrap.native_dispatch: existing admitted reader supplied by trusted server composition; no new HTTP/scheduler activation

reconciliation.input: Actual current-owner physical AEAD/source/context validation and existing fixed provider projectors; no caller rows
reconciliation.coverage: All complete two/three datasets and every page; existing holds cannot consume or replace
reconciliation.CAS: Expected prior day revision, unique source/operation, actual source read clocks newer than previous completion
reconciliation.replacement: Replace same native key value, never add; remove vanished rows only for verified complete same-owner/provider/account/connection/day/timezone scope
reconciliation.physical_verification: Recompute canonical digest from actual typed fact values after write, then atomic source consumed + consumer receipt + day checkpoint
reconciliation.checkpoint_scope: Exact source-to-Dataset day acceptance, not scheduler job completion/release
reconciliation.unknown: One write; lost reply never triggers automatic inspect/retry/new attempt
reconciliation.mismatch: Subtransaction rolls fact/consumption/head back; minimal mismatch ledger remains on pending new source
reconciliation.history: Previous encrypted source untouched; superseded storage/empty/D consumer receipts cannot claim current data or finality

privacy_retention: Existing synchronized3-year fixed report/source retention, source proof and mandatory scoped erasure remain binding; no new PII/archive/cleanup activation

native_holds.meta_nonempty_sales: Existing meta_sales_semantics_unproven holds; empty read is separately provable

synthetic_report_shopify_mapping_2026_11.boundary: After verified raw-source projection and before report packaging and write. Verify Shopify product and variant evidence while preparing the fixture. Read the current verified mapping once per exact identity within the test reconciliation. Retain native report facts and source provenance.
synthetic_report_shopify_mapping_2026_11.owner: The mapping must match the current provider, reporting account, workspace, installation, generation, Shopify shop, connection and selection. Private verified mapping lookup rechecks its existing rule, source, evidence and revision guards.

google_ads.report_identity: Exact native item ID by role, Merchant account, feed label and observed content language. Pay attention separately to product, sold product, and advertised product.
google_ads.required_bridge: A unique reviewed synthetic report-to-Merchant link for the exact owner, day and item, explicitly binding the Merchant data source and legacy-local discriminator. A formatted item ID alone cannot choose its Merchant context.
google_ads.coverage: Performance Max fixtures provide observed content language. A report that omits language, including the current standard Shopping fixture, remains unmapped in this prototype. Actual report-to-Merchant identity proof remains open.

klaviyo.report_identity: Exact event and Shopify Ordered Product metric must be present in the authenticated source pages. Use ProductID with its lexical type, and preserve the separate Variant ID and VariantID evidence states.
klaviyo.required_bridge: Exact match against the current verified mapping and its evidence. The documented variant must belong to the verified Shopify Product if present. Order claim and attribution semantics are unchanged.

synthetic_report_shopify_mapping_2026_11.failed_evidence: Missing mapping, missing report context, conflicting Merchant links and incompatible sales-role contexts produce no Shopify association. A purported current mapping with invalid or missing Shopify evidence stops before write. An available advertised mapping cannot be copied to a different unverified sold product.
synthetic_report_shopify_mapping_2026_11.verification: The composition test runs the current Shopify verifier, authenticated source readers, current mapping verification and scheduled reconciliation code through its write/receipt/closure request boundary. Shopify responses, stored mapping snapshots and the SQL adapter are synthetic in that composition test.

postgresql_rehearsal.scope: One local PostgreSQL rollback rehearsal under the existing dated one-day workload, source authority, quotas, and single verified closure. Both providers share the same synthetic Shopify installation; one verified identity per provider is seeded outside the clocks with encrypted fixture evidence and the existing owner-only ingestion. PostgreSQL verifies the lookup, report mapping retention, write, receipt and completed closure. The existing lookup stays owner-only in the test database adapter; app grants and all runtime entry points stay as before.
postgresql_rehearsal.workload: 1,000 Dataset rows and five packages per provider. Replace one Google performance row and one sales row with uniquely linked Performance Max rows. Replace one Klaviyo event with an exact Shopify ProductID and Variant ID. Require two mapped Google rows and one mapped Klaviyo row. This measures the stated coverage only; no per-1,000-mapped-row or live capacity inference.
postgresql_rehearsal.clocks: Report-mapping SQL lookup is inside report preparation and total. Record lookup time and count separately for visibility, with no addition to total. Synthetic provider traffic, no durable commit, no concurrent stores. The prior Google Shopping-only workload is not an exact performance control for this mixed Google fixture.
postgresql_rehearsal.klaviyo_mapping_retention: Use the existing independent source validators for the mapped Klaviyo rehearsal. The optional shared-day proof correctly rejects source table updates during the old optimization. Mapping retention writes trigger that invalidation. Retain original source and mapping checks and leave the older unlinked rehearsal unchanged. Reset the isolated report adapter's SQL timeouts at handoff to the earlier of the scheduled report's 30-second bound and the existing job deadline. The preceding 5-second raw-source SET LOCAL otherwise leaks across the release of the test savepoint. Record the different writer mode when reporting elapsed times.

synthetic_report_shopify_mapping_2026_11.meta: Outside this mapping prototype. Insights namespace and sales-role native acceptance stay open.

synthetic_meta_shopify_queue_to_close_20.scope: Exercise the existing Meta token debug and Insights reader and scheduled Dataset reconciliation for one fully eligible day on the same synthetic installation as the Google Ads and Klaviyo rehearsals. Use scoped PostgreSQL roles, real quota reservation and settlement for Meta and Shopify Partner, encrypted raw source write/readback, one reconciled consumer receipt, and a completed work order.
synthetic_meta_shopify_queue_to_close_20.workload: Three synthetic facts within the existing 200-row writer boundary: one ad performance fact and two product performance facts. Bind only the product with a unique exact synthetic report-to-catalog link to its independently verified Shopify Product ID. Assert the second product stays unmapped and no Meta product sales facts exist.
synthetic_meta_shopify_queue_to_close_20.boundary: Test-only binding after authenticated raw-source projection and before Dataset write. Physical HTTP responses are synthetic. No live provider, hosted database, runtime role grants or activation. Meta Insights identity namespace proof, native sales roles, and a 1,000-row comparison remain open.
